boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten documented UNL library spaces for quiet reading, group work, computer use, and meetings across City and East Campuses.

cards.title: Set up a group table at Love’s Collaboration Space
cards.subtitle: Love Library South, Level 2 · City Campus
cards.notes: Bring a small group, rearrange the movable tables and chairs, and use the padded seating for a collaborative work session.
cards.short_summary: A Level 2 Love Library space configured for collaborative study.
cards.evidence_claim: UNL Libraries lists the Love Library Collaboration Space as an active study space with movable desktops, chairs, and padded seating.
cards.access_notes: Check UNL Libraries location hours and building access information before visiting.

cards.title: Read or outline on the Love Library Mezzanine
cards.subtitle: Love Library South, Level 2 · City Campus
cards.notes: Choose a chair, couch, high-top, or desk tabletop; power outlets and natural light support a longer individual work block.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet Love Library area with varied seating and power.
cards.evidence_claim: UNL Libraries identifies the Mezzanine as a designated quiet space with chairs, couches, high-top and desk tabletops, natural light, and power outlets.
cards.access_notes: Located on Level 2 of Love Library South; check library hours before going.

cards.title: Find a movable desk in the Love Library Stacks
cards.subtitle: Love Library South, basement/lower level through Level 3A · City Campus
cards.notes: Use the movable desks and chairs for focused reading, then adjust the shades or seating as needed in the multi-level stacks.
cards.short_summary: Eight levels of designated quiet study space within Love Library South.
cards.evidence_claim: UNL Libraries describes the Love Library Stacks as designated quiet space across eight levels with movable desktops, chairs, padded seating, and power outlets.
cards.access_notes: The stacks span multiple Love Library South levels; consult library floor maps and hours.

cards.title: Work quietly in Reading Room 218
cards.subtitle: Love Library South, Level 2 · City Campus
cards.notes: Use a tabletop or wooden chair for quiet reading; movable whiteboards and wall outlets can support a planned study session.
cards.short_summary: A named quiet reading room with natural light, tables, whiteboards, and outlets.
cards.evidence_claim: UNL Libraries lists Quiet Reading Room 218 as a designated quiet space with natural light, movable tabletops and chairs, movable whiteboards, and wall power outlets.
cards.access_notes: Room 218 is on Level 2 of Love Library South; observe the designated quiet setting.

cards.title: Use a computer station at the Love LINK
cards.subtitle: Love Library South, Level 2 · City Campus
cards.notes: Bring a laptop or use a desktop station; monitors with HDMI cords, seating, and nearby natural light make it practical for digital work.
cards.short_summary: A Level 2 library space with computer stations, monitors, and varied seating.
cards.evidence_claim: UNL Libraries identifies the Love LINK as having computer stations, monitors with HDMI cords, varied seating, natural light, and desktop computers.
cards.access_notes: Located on Level 2 of Love Library South; check the Libraries site for current building hours.

cards.entity_name: Adele Hall Learning Commons Active Study Areas
cards.title: Meet around a whiteboard at Adele Hall
cards.subtitle: Adele Hall Learning Commons, northeast and northwest corners · City Campus
cards.notes: Use the open seating, computer stations, monitors, and mobile whiteboards to map out a shared assignment or presentation.
cards.short_summary: Two corners of Adele Hall set up for active, technology-supported study.
cards.evidence_claim: UNL Libraries lists the northeast and northwest corners of Adele Hall Learning Commons as active study spaces with open seating, computer stations, monitors, mobile whiteboards, and outlets.
cards.access_notes: Adele Hall is on Level 1 of Love Library North; check Libraries hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Adele Hall Learning Commons Quiet Reading Room
cards.title: Choose the quiet reading room at Adele Hall
cards.subtitle: Adele Hall Learning Commons, southwest corner · City Campus
cards.notes: Take a padded seat, couch chair, or table in the southwest corner when you need a designated quiet place to read or write.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet room in Adele Hall with natural light and flexible seating.
cards.evidence_claim: UNL Libraries identifies the Adele Hall Learning Commons Quiet Reading Room in the southwest corner as a designated quiet space with varied seating, tabletops, natural light, and outlets.
cards.access_notes: The room is in Love Library North Level 1; keep conversation low in this designated quiet area.

cards.entity_name: Dinsdale Family Learning Commons Active Study Space
cards.title: Use Dinsdale’s active study floors
cards.subtitle: Dinsdale Family Learning Commons, first and second floors · East Campus
cards.notes: Pick open seating on the first or second floor, use a mobile whiteboard, and connect a laptop to a monitor for group work.
cards.short_summary: East Campus active-study floors with open seating, whiteboards, monitors, and outlets.
cards.evidence_claim: UNL Libraries lists Dinsdale Family Learning Commons first and second floors as active study space with open seating, mobile whiteboards, outlets, tabletops, and first-floor computers and monitors.
cards.access_notes: Dinsdale is on East Campus; check library hours and floor maps before traveling over.

cards.entity_name: Dinsdale Family Learning Commons Lower-Level Quiet Study Area
cards.title: Settle into Dinsdale’s lower-level quiet area
cards.subtitle: Dinsdale Family Learning Commons, lower level · East Campus
cards.notes: Use the open seating or desk tabletops for quiet work; the lower level also has whiteboards, computers, monitors, and outlets.
cards.short_summary: A lower-level designated quiet space at the East Campus learning commons.
cards.evidence_claim: UNL Libraries lists Dinsdale’s lower level as a designated quiet space with open seating, mobile whiteboards, power outlets, tabletops, computers, monitors, and natural light.
cards.access_notes: Use the lower-level quiet reading area and confirm current Dinsdale hours before arrival.

cards.title: Share a work table at Architecture Library
cards.subtitle: Architecture Hall, first floor · City Campus
cards.notes: Use the library’s active-study seating for a small work session, and reserve a room when your group needs a dedicated setup.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor Architecture Hall library with active study space and reservable rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: UNL Libraries identifies Architecture Library in Architecture Hall as an active study space with varied seating and reservable rooms for up to six people.
cards.access_notes: UNL Libraries lists this branch as NCard access only; confirm access requirements and hours before visiting.
